'''Saché''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as one of the [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens/Legends|handmaidens]] of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Biography==
[[File:Sache.jpg|thumb|left|Saché, during the Galactic Civil War]]
Saché was one of the younger [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]], [[Yané/Legends|Yané]] being the youngest.<ref name="Blog-teekay-421|32">{{Blog|teekay-421|32|Handmaiden ID Roster}}</ref> She and the other handmaidens were trained in self-defense and marksmanship by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] head of security, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Panaka]].<ref name="Queen in Disguise">''[[Queen in Disguise]]''</ref>

During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Trade Federation Crisis]], Saché and Yané remained behind when the queen and the other three handmaidens fled [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="TPM" />

Of all the handmaidens, Saché was the only one not to attend the [[Freedom of Naboo/Legends|Celebration Parade]], even though she was present at Qui-Gon Jinn's [[Funeral of Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|funeral ceremony]].<ref name="TPM" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Saché was present in the [[Mauler Stronghold]], the headquarters of the group of [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] known as the [[Maulers]], situated near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]].<ref name="SWG:MS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=location|Mauler Stronghold|Naboo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I asked George if I could come and watch the shoot, and he asked if I wanted to be in the royal entourage. (&hellip;) I'm at the back with a hood on and you can't really see me. I don't even remember what my character was called.|Sofia Coppola, about her role as Saché|<ref name="Empire">{{WebCite|url=https://www.empireonline.com/movies/features/sofia-coppola-sofia-coppola|text=Sofia Coppola: Film By Film: From ''The Godfather Part III'' to ''The Bling Ring'' {{C|Page 8}}|accessdate=May 13, 2014|archivedate=20181206061826}}</ref>}}
Saché was portrayed by [[Sofia Coppola]] in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> Coppola considers [[George Lucas]], a long-time friend and working partner of her father [[Wikipedia:Francis Ford Coppola|Francis Ford Coppola]], "like an uncle to me&mdash;he used to send me and my brother [[Wikipedia:Roman Coppola|Roman]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' toys when we were little," and upon hearing he was going back to the saga, "thought it'd be so fun to see how they make them" as she was preparing her own directorial debut, [[Wikipedia:The Virgin Suicides (film)|''The Virgin Suicides'']]. When she asked Lucas if she could attend the shoot, he offered her the role of Saché, and she accepted as "it seemed like a good vantage point to watch without getting in the way."<ref name="Empire" />

Saché was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Saché was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> Saché and four other Queen Amidala's handmaidens — [[Eirtaé/Legends|Eirtaé]], [[Rabé/Legends|Rabé]], [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]] and [[Yané/Legends|Yané]] — were intended to be featured in a quest named "Helping the Handmaidens," included in the Naboo part of the so-called "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the longest questline in the game.<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|directory tree files}}</ref> The quest was never finalized and the handmaidens did not make her way to the game but Saché. Hence, this character was not involved in any quest.<ref name="SWG:MS" />
